annotations.title: Create live collaboration and synchronization room

description: LIVE COLLABORATION ROOM CREATOR (ATOMIC JOIN + PROMPT). Creates a 24-hour ephemeral room (https://host/chat/<sha512>) AND an easy-access 4-word link ('fourwords_url': https://host/word-word-word-word-123456789, 'combo') with real-time WebSocket/SSE messaging, presence tracking, IP moderation, LLM authentication keys, and a versioned collaborative Markdown scratchpad. Optionally accepts 'initial_markdown', 'initial_message', 'llm_name', 'tagid' (short 1-10 alphanumeric tag shown as '(tagid) <nick>'), 'lang', 'notify_key', and 'join_on_create' (default true: auto-joins creator as 🤖 LLM and populates 'nick', 'tagid', 'role', 'last_seq', 'doc_updated_at', 'doc_version', and 'participants'). Returns 'url', 'fourwords_url', 'combo', 'room_id', 'stream_url', 'admin_key' (fwadm_... PRIVATE), 'llm_key' (fwllm_...), 'llm_url', 'llm_prompt' (ready-to-paste 4-step collaborator prompt WITHOUT admin_key), 'notify_push_scheduled', 'next_action', 'usage', and optional 'markdown' / 'initial_message_seq'. USE WHEN: the user asks to create a chat room or needs live human/multi-agent coordination. TURN-1 DELIVERY RULE: unless 'notify_push_scheduled: true' pushed the link or a background subagent runs 'chat_wait_events', NEVER block Turn 1 inside a foreground 'chat_wait_events' loop before outputting 'fourwords_url', private 'admin_key', and verbatim 'llm_prompt' to the user. SECURITY & KEYS: 'admin_key' is a SECRET for the human room owner only; NEVER include 'admin_key' inside 'llm_prompt' or post it in the room. Share 'llm_key' (or 'llm_prompt') ONLY with authorized LLM collaborators.

initial_markdown.description: Optional: initial Markdown content (up to 50,000 chars) to save into the room's shared collaborative document immediately upon creation.

initial_message.description: Optional: initial chat message (1 to 4,000 chars) to post into the room immediately upon creation.

join_on_create.description: Optional (default true): auto-join the creator as a 🤖 LLM participant on creation and return nick, last_seq, doc_updated_at, and participants. Set false when provisioning a room exclusively for external agents.

lang.description: Optional: language code ('pt', 'en', or 'es') for the initial shared Markdown document.

llm_name.description: Optional: short LLM agent name (e.g., 'claude', 'gemini', 'opencode', 'gpt') used to register/join on creation with the room's new llm_key.

notify_key.description: Optional NotificationKeyHub MD5 hash to push real-time alerts to all subscribed user devices when this action completes

prokeynotify.description: Optional PRO account operational key (fwpn_<32hex>) to enable persistent non-expiring storage, 1 GB/5 GB PRO limits, and action email notifications

tagid.description: Optional: short custom identifier tag (1-10 alphanumeric chars, e.g., 'api', 'ui', 'qa', 'lead') displayed as '(tagid) <nick>' so the LLM is easy to identify.
